description: Polish company annual-accounts filings recorded in the official KRS register extract (Ministry of Justice open API, live, 24 h cache): every filing since registration, newest first: financial statements (own and consolidated) with their filing date, auditor's report, approval resolution, management report, sustainability attestation, each with the period covered. Metadata only, never the figures or the document: the Financial Documents Repository (RDF) has no open API. aucun_depot: true is what the extract shows, not a proof of non-filing. A legal form off the served list (foreign entrepreneur or its branch, professional partnership) returns 404, not billed. 10-digit KRS number. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

krs.description: 10-digit Polish KRS number, leading zeros included, e.g. 0000034143

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: list_polish_company_filings

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Polish company annual-accounts filings (KRS)
